name: Agenda
author: WinDock
description: The next event of the dock's calendar feeds (Settings > Calendar): how long until it starts ("In 25 min", "Now", the time) and its title; a click shows the next events in a popup, the month calendar or an app / address. It wakes only when what it shows changes: at an event's start or end, each minute of the last hour before one, at midnight, and when the feeds change.

settings.label: Events in the popup
settings.description: How many upcoming events the popup lists. Default: 6.

settings.label: Look ahead (days)
settings.description: Events further away are not shown (the slot then says "No events").

settings.label: Show locations in the popup
settings.description: Adds each event's location after its time in the popup. On by default.

settings.label: Only these feeds
settings.description: Feed names, comma separated (Settings > Calendar). Empty: every feed.

settings.label: A click opens
settings.description: What a click on the widget opens: the next events, the month calendar, or the app or address below. Default: the next events.

settings.label: App or address
settings.description: For "The app or address below": a program, a file or a URL (https://calendar.google.com).

settings.label: Width (DIPs, horizontal docks)
settings.description: How wide the widget is on a top or bottom dock. Default: 160.
